_comment: Default binding for the UDCAP VR Glove, which emulates a Valve Index
controller (``controller_type = knuckles``) at the SteamVR layer.
Three separate groups of sources are bound here:
1. Skeleton actions -> /user/hand/{l,r}/input/skeleton/{left,right}.
Not guaranteed to work: most knuckles-emulator drivers don't
actually implement CreateSkeletonComponent.  The binding still
needs to be present so the action exists, but skeleton data may
stay inactive (``bActive == False``).  In that case the retargeter
falls through to the finger-curl actions below.
2. Trigger + grip as vector1 (mode: trigger with ``pull`` input).
Used by GR1T2FourierUDCAPDevice to bypass the sampler's legacy
``getControllerState()`` path, which returns zeros for most
knuckles emulators.  Also feeds the button-grip fallback.
3. Per-finger curl (10 vector1 actions) bound as TRIGGER at
/user/hand/{l,r}/input/finger/{thumb,index,middle,ring,pinky}.
CRITICAL: the per-finger inputs on both the Valve Index profile
(index_controller_profile.json) and the UDCAP profile
(UDCAP_profile.json) declare ``type: "trigger"`` for these
paths.  Using ``mode: force_sensor`` triggers SteamVR to log
``Invalid input type force for controller (/user/hand/.../finger/...)``
and silently drop ALL ten finger bindings.  The correct mode is
``trigger`` with ``pull`` as the input key — same shape as the
main trigger binding above.
description: UDCAP (Index-profile) default binding: skeleton + trigger/grip + 10 per-finger curl
name: UST Teleop — Index profile + per-finger curl
